name: MITRE NERVE
desc: A nation-state actor intrusion starting in Jan 2024. © 2024 The MITRE Corporation. Approved for public release. Document number CT0121.

acts.d: The adversary compromises MITRE's NERVE system through multiple zero-day vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure.
The adversary installs ROOTROT web shell to maintain persistence.
The adversary highjacks multiple RDP sessions to move laterally into the VMware environment, bypassing MFA. This includes some administrator some and unprivileged sessions.
The adversary stages data for exfiltration in /dana-na/help/.
The adversary gains access to legitimate user accounts.
WIREFIRE responses are encrypted with AES, base-64 encoded, and gzipped.
WIREFIRE payloads masquerade as GIF files.
The adversary enumerates files to exfiltrate.
The adversary connects from the Ivanti appliance to multiple VMs in the NERVE environment using compromised credentials.
The adversary collects data from the local system.
The adversary accesses the user's bookmarks to enumerate additional assets.
The adversary enumerates file shares.
The adversary clones the vCenter VM and creates several other VMs.
The adversary uses the vCenter web API to enumerate drives, both mounted and unmounted.
BRICKSTORM modifies the rc.local script so that the implant starts automatically on boot.
BRICKSTORM uses an init.d script so that the implant starts automatically on boot.
The adversary executes a Python script.
The adversary uses BUSHWALK's export feature to stage tarballs for exfiltration.
The adversary automates the collection of documents to exfiltrate.
The adversary connects to their rogue VMs.
BRICKSTORM communicates with C2 domains over HTTP.
The adversary exfiltrates several gigabytes of data.
The adversary collects data from the local system.
The adversary exfiltrates several documents.
